en: Black-and-white image of a grand, symmetrical Beaux-Arts style palace-like building with richly ornamented façades, domed corner pavilions, and a central section topped by a flagpole and dome. In front lies a formal garden with winding gravel paths, manicured flowerbeds, shrubs, and small trees. A few people in early-20th‑century clothing stroll or stand on the paths. The sky area is blank and there are no visible inscriptions or border decorations on the image itself.
